decision: Saved views and facets with counts live in a persistent sidebar
why: Merchandisers return to the same slices daily; counts tell them where the work is before they click.
alternative: A search box with advanced filter dialogs.
value: Scanning 1,300 SKUs becomes a list of 24 decisions.

decision: 13 px rows with a 28-day sparkline and one status tag per SKU
why: HQ users compare many products at once; trend shape matters more than exact values here.
value: Twice as many rows per screen, and the outliers are visible at a glance.

decision: Catalog reads come from a denormalised read model, not the transactional store
why: Facet counts and sparklines join sales, stock and pricing; computing them per request is slow and contends with writes.
alternative: Query the product, stock and sales tables live.

decision: The pricing agent is invoked on a selection, never across the catalog on its own
why: Scope is a human choice; the agent should work on what a merchandiser is already looking at.
value: Every proposal has an owner and a reason to exist.

decision: Statuses such as 'Low margin' are derived from price and cost events
why: A stored status goes stale; a derived one changes the moment cost or price does.
value: The 'needs action' view is always current.
